goals: Provide visual and render compatibility for Translucent Glass treatment across glass families used through BGE-owned geometry and BGE-mediated material behavior.
Consume Block Geometry Extensions as the canonical Workbench integration layer without recreating or separately coupling to the retired CNM × Nibaru project identity.
scope: Preserve Translucent Glass translucency and visual treatment on applicable BGE-owned glass-family geometry while retaining the canonical material relationship supplied through BGE.
Cover clear and stained full-block baselines plus slab, stair, wall, vertical-slab, and step variants only where the current BGE architecture actually exposes them.

Preserve Translucent Glass-specific placed and item rendering, same-family adjacency, mixed full-block and derived-geometry seams, translucent depth ordering, and Complementary shader presentation without taking ownership of general BGE connected-texture behavior.

Choose the narrowest implementation only after auditing the exact current stack: automatic inheritance first, a focused resource-pack layer if required, and focused client/render code only when resource behavior cannot satisfy the approved scope.

exclusions: Implementation source, build files, generated assets, artifacts, Canary versions, and speculative scaffolding while the project remains PLANNED.
Changes to Block Geometry Extensions, its material-family or geometry ownership, or any separate Workbench dependency on the legacy CNM × Nibaru project identity.

General source-to-BGE and BGE-to-BGE connected-texture architecture, which is separately owned by BGE × CTM project UUID 5747a309-1bd5-4280-b25c-98669e149928; this project checks only Translucent Glass-specific composition with that behavior.
A competing material registry, registry-name parsing, copied family mappings, collapsed glass or stained-glass variants, or gameplay-semantic changes.
Compatibility for unrelated transparent materials or geometry and variants not actually exposed through BGE.
Runtime deployment, Minecraft validation claims, originals, and unrelated project or Workbench state during this administrative migration.

dependencies.reason: Block Geometry Extensions is the canonical Workbench dependency and integration layer for the geometry and material behavior this project must consume.
Provides the target translucent-glass visual treatment; the exact current artifact, built-in resources, and version must be established before implementation.
Provides the runtime connected-texture behavior against which Translucent Glass-specific composition must be checked; general BGE CTM ownership remains with the separate BGE × CTM project.

state.milestone: The post-launch visual and render compatibility scope is approved; implementation has not started.
